newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Ceska Sporitelna Q1 net falls.
newsitem.headline: Czech Ceska Sporitelna Q1 net falls.

text.p: Czech savings bank Ceska Sporitelna's net profit fell to 632 million crowns in the first quarter of 1997 from 636 million a year earlier, finance department chief Helena Rydlova told Reuters on Monday.

Rydlova said the bank, whose shares are listed on the main market of the Prague Stock Exchange, expected a net profit of 2.5 billion crowns in 1997, compared with 1.9 billion last year, according to Czech accounting standards.
She had no other details of the first-quarter results.
